root_cause.collision: arpg_gathering_work_core.py::_insert_node() line 210-216 recomputes the node definition (including capacity_units, sourced from that same mutable country.fauna.count) on every engine boot via _bootstrap_nodes(), and raises IntegrityError if the recomputed hash differs from the one persisted at first bootstrap. capacity_units was never designed to be re-synced after the initial insert.
